title: moon travel
description: New dimension. /moon to teleport /earth to teleport back
body:
A hardcore space survival plugin that turns the Pale Dimension into a lifeless, oxygen-free Moon with low gravity, cosmic horror sounds, and custom environmental hazards.

Full Description (Полное описание — для главной страницы)

MoonTravel is a lightweight, immersive survival plugin that transforms the Pale Dimension into a harsh, realistic lunar landscape. Perfect for space-themed survival servers!
🚀 Features:

    Lunar Gravity: Experience authentic, custom low gravity while exploring the Moon.

    No Oxygen (Suffocation): The Moon has no atmosphere. You will slowly suffocate and take damage unless you are wearing specialized gear or stay inside a sealed base.

    Sealed Oxygen Stations: Build your own lunar outpost! Using an advanced Flood Fill algorithm, the plugin checks if your room is 100% airtight. Place a Crafter and a Burning Furnace inside a sealed room to generate breathable oxygen.

    Cosmic Horror Atmosphere: No mobs spawn on the Moon, and it never rains, leaving you in complete, eerie isolation. Random space ambient noises, distant echo clicks, and creepy sounds will keep you on edge.

    Space Physics: Beds explode when you try to sleep on the Moon, and placing water instantly freezes it into ice.

    Easy Navigation: Simple commands to travel between worlds: /moon to launch into space and /earth to return safely home.

💻 Commands:

    /moon — Teleport to the Moon (Pale Dimension).

    /earth — Return to the Overworld spawn point.
